verdicts.evidence: No author code, executable DGP, processed MIMIC-III data, or hyperparameters/seeds were available; no experiments were run to produce RMSE numbers.
Same blockers as Claim 1: no code, data, or hyperparameters available; the expanded DGP delegates to undefined limited-DGP equations and no comparison was executed.
No author code, executable DGP, processed data, or hyperparameters were available; no dynamic-policy RMSE experiments were run.

An independent implementation on 5 threshold policies with 240 synthetic histories computed Gaussian-kernel MMD and metric MDS, achieving distance-order rank correlation 1.000 and finite 2D embeddings, but on a clearly reduced synthetic setup.

Concrete counterexample: identical initial Q values (0.5, 0.5) with bounded fluctuations (0.8, -0.8) and treatment probability 0.5 yield targeted Q values 0.689974 and 0.310026, a difference of 0.379949 despite zero initial difference, violating any finite Lipschitz bound.
No cohort SQL, MIMIC item IDs, preprocessing rules, model code, checkpoints, or seeds were released; protected data download was incomplete; no experiments were run.

overall: The logbook independently implements the MMD-to-MDS policy embedding pipeline on a small synthetic setup and provides a concrete numerical counterexample to the Theorem 4.2 Lipschitz guarantee, but cannot reproduce any empirical RMSE comparison or the MIMIC-IV sepsis case study due to missing code and protected data.
